items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: So I said, 'Listen, Biddie, I'm afraid --,' He said, 'Oh, think nothing of it.

ctx.x: And he says, 'Do you think you could hold the job down? I'll just be gone a couple of weeks.' So I said, 'Listen, Biddie, I'm afraid --,' He said, 'Oh, think nothing of it. I'll be here a couple of days and you come every night and I'll show you just how it goes.
But you had to play for dancers.
